extraction_notes: The supplied four-page datasheet is headed BC856 and explicitly identifies the BC856B hFE classification range as 220 to 475; the exact extracted MPN is BC856B.
The datasheet does not state a revision, so datasheet_identity.revision is recorded as not stated rather than inferred.

Page 2 typical-characteristics plots are treated as usable family evidence for BC856B. Curve points are sparse approximate manual digitizations of visible traces at labeled grid positions; no points were interpolated between plotted observations.

PNP collector-current, base-current, collector-emitter-voltage, base-emitter-voltage, VCEsat, and VBEsat coordinates retain the datasheet negative signs. Curve axes labeled in mA, MHz, pF, and mW were represented in SI units A, Hz, F, and W; ambient temperature remains in degC.

The hFE table is a generic BC856 row, while the classification table gives BC856B a guaranteed range of 220 to 475 at VCE = -5 V and IC = -2 mA. The two gain_points preserve minimum and maximum semantics and do not invent a typical value.

The table provides one guaranteed maximum VCE(sat) and VBE(sat) pair at IC = -100 mA and IB = -5 mA. The plotted saturation traces are typical curves at beta = 20 and remain separate from the guaranteed table values.

Cobo is a guaranteed maximum table value at VCE = -10 V. The page 2 Cib curve is retained as typical digitized curve evidence, but cibo remains null because the supplied table gives no numeric Cib specification.
The page 2 fT curve is typical at VCE = -5 V and Ta = 25 degC. The table fT entry is preserved separately as a guaranteed minimum at IC = -10 mA and measurement frequency f = 100 MHz.
